title: 第十一章 来接你回家
novel_title: 纨绔女修四处撩，绿茶狼崽黑化了
content_zh:
萧姚盯着只有自己能看到的倒计时，一动不动。

    【死亡倒计时：359天23小时。】

    倒计时又跳下去一个小时，萧姚的太阳穴也跟着突突跳。

    她活动活动僵硬的脖子，低头看着桌上的传讯符，点开祁妙传回来的压缩包，叹了口气。

    虽然她有点良心难安，但她还是更想保住小命。

    萧姚翻来覆去，把几人的详细信息研究了一晚上，直到早课钟响，她才揉揉干涩的眼睛，拖着长腔喊：

    “小狼～”

    无人回应。

    025凉凉开口：

    【这会儿想起来他了？晚了，人早跑了。】

    萧姚腾得站起来。

    她好不容易把人押在眼皮子底下重点盯着，结果才两天，人就躲起来了？

    那她不白费劲了！

    【知不知道他去哪了？】

    【不知道，我的视野只有你方圆十米的范围。】

    萧姚：……

    果然指望不上。

    萧姚“啧”了一声，轻车熟路地戳上祁妙：

    【找找苍岚。】

    祁妙的效率出奇的高：

    【大小姐，问天广场西南角，发现苍岚师弟身影。】

    萧姚眉头微皱。

    怎么跑那里去了？

    【原因。】

    祁妙回答得干脆：

    【曹长老授课，内外门弟子均可参与。】

    萧姚提起的心重新放回肚里。

    原来不是被她吓跑的，也不是刻意躲着她。

    那就好。

    萧姚伸了个懒腰，准备换身衣服出门，习惯性走到衣架旁去拿挂着的外袍，手却抓了个空。

    嗯？

    萧姚抬眼一瞧。

    哦，原来是叠起来了。

    她的洞府里，除了她就是苍岚，是他叠的啊，还挺整齐呢，甚至熏了香。

    挺贴心，很喜欢。

    萧姚穿戴整齐，推门而出，目光又被门边的绒毛吸引。

    这是苍岚的狼毛？

    萧姚蹲下，捏了一撮，用手指捻了捻，脑中灵光一现，脚下立马调转方向，又拐回屋里。

    反正距离散课还有些时间，那就再给小狼做个小手工，趁热打铁刷好感呗～

    ……

    苍岚坐在广场的右后角，尽可能地往阴影里藏。

    曹静言讲解的解炼器常识，苍岚左耳进右耳出，入耳不入心。

    因为他的心里实在是太乱了。
content_en:
Xiao Yao stared at the countdown that only he could see, motionless.

[Countdown to death: 359 days and 23 hours.】

The countdown jumped for another hour, and Xiao Yao's temples also jumped.

She moved her stiff neck, looked down at the communication talisman on the table, opened the compressed package Qi Miao sent back, and sighed.

Although her conscience was a bit uneasy, she still wanted to save her life.

Xiao Yao tossed and turned and studied the detailed information of several people all night long. It was not until the morning class bell rang that she rubbed her dry eyes and shouted in a long voice:

"Little Wolf~"

No one responded.

025 Liangliang said:

[Remember him now?It's too late, people have already run away.】

Xiao Yaoteng had to stand up.

She finally managed to keep the person under her nose and keep a close eye on him, but only two days later, the person was hiding?

Then her efforts were not in vain!

[Do you know where he went?】

[I don’t know, my field of vision is only within a ten-meter radius of you.】

Xiao Yao:......

Sure enough, I can't count on it.

Xiao Yao made a "tsk" sound and poked Qi Miao with ease:

[Look for Cang Lan.】

Qi Miao’s efficiency is surprisingly high:

[Miss, Junior Brother Cang Lan was spotted in the southwest corner of Wentian Square.】

Xiao Yao frowned slightly.

Why did you get there?

【reason.】

Qi Miao answered simply:

[Elder Cao teaches classes, and both inner and outer disciples can participate.】

Xiao Yao's heart returned to his stomach.

It turned out that he was not scared away by her, nor was he deliberately avoiding her.

That's good.

Xiao Yao stretched out and was about to change his clothes and go out. He walked to the hanger to pick up the hanging robe out of habit, but his hand was empty.

Um?

Xiao Yao looked up.

Oh, it turns out they are stacked.

In her cave, apart from her, there was Cang Lan. He folded the piles, and they were quite neat and even scented with incense.

Very considerate, I like it very much.

Xiao Yao dressed neatly and pushed out the door. His eyes were attracted by the fluff beside the door.

Is this Cang Lan’s wolf hair?

Xiao Yao squatted down, pinched a handful, and twisted it with his fingers. An idea flashed in his mind, and he immediately changed direction and turned back into the house.

Anyway, there is still some time before class ends, so let’s make another little handicraft for Xiaolang, and strike while the iron is hot to gain a good impression~

…

Cang Lan sat in the back right corner of the square, hiding in the shadows as much as possible.

The common sense of refining weapons explained by Cao Jingyan went in one ear and out the other, but not in the heart.

Because he was really too confused.
title_en: Chapter 11: Coming to take you home
